g.text: Indian news channels in one clean, fast player
Searchable channel list with category and language filters
HLS and DASH live playback with Widevine DRM support for licensed feeds
Official free YouTube live streams from news broadcasters
Auto-reconnect, picture-in-picture, fullscreen and channel up/down
Private AI bookkeeping for freelancers and consultants
Drop in invoices and receipts; an open-weight AI model extracts the key details
Categorises each one and builds a clean, organised ledger
Runs on your own device, so client financial data never reaches a third-party cloud
Premium black-and-gold interface with an interactive 3D vault
Turns raw application logs into a clear incident overview
Automatic grouping of similar errors (Drain-style clustering)
Log explorer, timelines and service insights
Likely root-cause clues and suggested remediation steps
Incident resolve/reopen controls and JSON report export
Upload or paste logs → Parse → Cluster → Rank → Investigate
Hackathon prototype: some dashboards and integration statuses use demo data.
Marking an incident resolved does not fix external systems automatically.
